title: next breakfast
excerpt: We had another great time at the daily grind today – we’ll do it again at 8:30 a.m. on March 24. “Behold how good and how pleasant it is when Southern Baptists, Lutherans, Jewish-Episcopalians, Eastern Orthodox, and others breakfast together in unity.”
